reading.notes:
Source file: /Volumes/Extreme SSD/Spring - Forest on the moon/DIRT/Sources/datasheets/Hispansion/TLH-0_TDS_v1.4.pdf, read with pdftotext -layout (text extracted cleanly, no garbled tables, so no page rendering was needed).

Mapping notes:
- The sheet's Section 2.3 "Density" gives four distinct values (Minimum, Maximum, Mean, Particle Density). Mapped Mean Density -> bulk_density, Minimum+Maximum -> bulk_density_range (combined from two separate printed lines, both endpoints explicitly stated, not inferred), and Particle Density -> density_g_cm3 (no separate "specific gravity" term appears anywhere on the sheet, so that field is not_stated).
- oxide:* values taken only from "Table 1: Bulk Chemistry of TLH-0 (%)" (the product's own XRF/ICP-MS results). "Table 2: Apollo Bulk Chemistry – Highlands Reference (%)" (sourced from Slabic et al. 2024) was excluded per instructions as reference data, not the product's own values.
- mineral:* values taken only from "Table 4: Modal Mineralogy of TLH-0 (%)" (the XRD/Raman phase table). "Table 5: Mineral Group Classification of TLH-0 (%)" is a re-grouped roll-up of the same data into 5 mineral-group buckets (Pyroxene, Plagioclase Feldspar, Olivine, Ilmenite, Glass), not itself a modal mineralogy table, so it was not used for mineral: entries; "Table 6" is the Apollo reference version of that grouping and was excluded as reference data.
- Trace elements (Table 3, ppm, XRF/ICP-MS) were excluded per instructions (not oxides).
- The Overview section's "Composition" list (Anorthosite, Basalt, Altered Peridotite) is the feedstock blend the product is made from, not a modal mineralogy table, so it was excluded per instructions.
- Reflectance spectra (Tables 7–8, Section 2.8) and Apollo spectral-comparison metrics were not requested fields and were skipped.
- particle_morphology combines both shape descriptors printed in Section 2.5 (aspect ratio and root form factor/circularity), as the sheet reports morphology only as these two separate metrics, not a single descriptor.
- datasheet_document_id "TDS-TLH-0-v1.4" appears on the title page beneath the sheet's title, matching the filename's version tag (v1.4).
- PRODUCT designation "(S065)" from the task prompt does not appear anywhere on the datasheet itself; it was not used as part of any reported value.

reading.notes:
Read via pdftotext -layout (text layer was clean; no page needed image rendering). Excluded per rules: Table 2 "Apollo Bulk Chemistry – Low-Ti Mare Reference" (p.2), Table 6 "Apollo Mineral Group Classification – Low-Ti Mare Reference" (p.3), Table 3 trace elements in ppm (p.2, Nb/V/Co/...), and Table 7/8 Apollo reflectance-spectra comparison (p.6-7) — none are TLM-0's own bulk-chemistry/mineralogy values. Table 5 "Mineral Group Classification of TLM-0" (p.3: Pyroxene 19.1, Plagioclase Feldspar 35.2, Olivine 2.1, Ilmenite 0, Glass 31.4) is a derived regrouping of Table 4's phases, not "the modal mineralogy table" itself, so its rows were not reported as separate mineral: fields (Table 4 was used instead).

Mapping judgment calls (not inferred/computed values, just which printed label answers which requested field):
- density_g_cm3 -> the sheet's "Particle Density: 2.79 g/cm3" (2.3 Bulk Density, p.3), the only plain grain/solid density in g/cm3, distinct from Minimum/Maximum/Mean (bulk) Density.
- bulk_density_range -> built by pairing the sheet's separately printed "Minimum Density: 1.33 g/cm3" and "Maximum Density: 2.01 g/cm3" lines (2.3 Bulk Density, p.3); both are explicitly stated, nothing was computed.
- glass_content_percent -> Table 4's "Amorphous/Glass" column (31.4), matching the XRD glass/amorphous-fraction quantification described in section 2.2's intro text.

Product info for context (not requested fields but useful): Type = Low-Ti Mare; Series = TerraLun®-Core; Composition (feedstock blend, not mineralogy) = Basalt, Anorthosite, Altered Peridotite.
